title: Why default and static interface methods were introduced
answer: Default methods were introduced so interfaces could evolve by adding behavior without immediately breaking every existing implementation. Static interface methods provide utilities closely related to the contract without requiring an instance or a separate helper type. They preserve the interface as the natural home for behavior tied directly to that API.
